chapters.title: Periodic Table and Periodic Properties
chapters.main_concept: Development of the periodic table (Dobereiner, Newlands, Mendeleev, Meyer, Moseley), the structure of the modern table (periods, groups, blocks, families), and the periodic trends in atomic/ionic radius, ionization energy, electron affinity, electronegativity and metallic character. Closes with Period 3 chemistry: reactions of Na and Mg, bonding/acid-base character and oxidation numbers of oxides and chlorides.

chapters.title: Chemical Bonding
chapters.main_concept: Lewis view of ionic, covalent and dative bonds and expanded octets, bond polarity and dipole moments from electronegativity, then the three bonding models: VSEPR (AB2-AB6 shapes, drug-design application), valence bond theory with sigma/pi overlap and sp3/sp2/sp hybridization, and molecular orbital theory with MO diagrams and bond orders of He2, N2, O2. Ends with bond energy/length data and a comparison of bond strengths with intermolecular forces.
